name: Lexus
overview: Toyota's luxury division launched in Australia in May 1990, redefining premium ownership through obsessive build quality, hybrid technology, and the Lexus Encore service program.
australian_history:
Lexus officially entered the Australian luxury vehicle market in May 1990 with a single, devastatingly refined model: the LS400 flagship sedan. Engineered under the 'Circle F' program at a cost of over $1 billion USD, the LS400 featured an acoustically silent 4.0L 1UZ-FE quad-cam V8 and tolerances so precise that it stunned the German luxury establishment.

Complementing the vehicle's engineering was the Lexus Encore Privileges program, which introduced Australian luxury buyers to complimentary pickup and delivery for servicing, loan cars, golf days, and opera sponsorships, setting a new benchmark for customer care.

In 1992, Lexus expanded with the ES300 mid-size sedan, followed in 1997 by the GS300 executive sports sedan. In 1998, Lexus launched its first luxury 4WD, the LX470, combining the bulletproof underpinnings of the LandCruiser 100 with hydraulic suspension and opulent Connolly leather. In 1999, the compact IS200 arrived to challenge the BMW 3 Series.

In 2003, Lexus introduced the RX330 luxury SUV, which rapidly became the brand's volume backbone in Australia. In 2006, Lexus pioneered luxury hybrid motoring in Australia with the RX400h and GS450h. In 2007, Lexus launched the high-performance 'F' brand with the IS F, packing a 5.0L 2UR-GSE V8 with 311kW. In 2011, Australia received fewer than 10 allocations of the carbon-fibre LFA V10 supercar, priced over $700,000. Today, Lexus Australia commands strong luxury market share led by the NX, RX, and UX hybrid and electric SUVs.

ls.name: LS
ls.overview: The original Japanese flagship that disrupted the global luxury market in 1990 with the whispering 1UZ-FE V8.

generations.summary: 4.0L 1UZ-FE V8 190kW, 4-speed auto, pioneering NVH reduction, established Lexus in Australia.
4.0L V8 updated with VVT-i (216kW), 5-speed auto, increased rear legroom.
4.3L 3UZ-FE V8 207kW, radar cruise control, soft-close doors, Mark Levinson audio.
4.6L 1UR-FSE V8 (285kW) and world-first V8 hybrid LS600hL (5.0L 2UR-FSE AWD 327kW).
GA-L platform, 3.5L Twin-Turbo V6 (V35A-FTS 310kW) and 3.5L Multi-Stage Hybrid.

is.name: IS
is.overview: Rear-wheel-drive compact sports sedan famous for chronograph instruments, the V8 IS F, and agile dynamics.

generations.summary: 2.0L 1G-FE inline-6 and 3.0L 2JZ-GE inline-6, chronograph watch-dial instruments.
2.5L 4GR-FSE V6, 3.5L 2GR-FSE; 5.0L V8 IS F (311kW) high-performance hero in 2008.
Spindle grille styling, 2.0L Turbo (IS300), 2.5L Hybrid (IS300h), and 3.5L V6 (IS350 232kW).

rx.name: RX
rx.overview: Lexus's most successful model in Australia, pioneering luxury crossover comfort and hybrid efficiency.

generations.summary: 3.3L 3MZ-FE V6 (RX330) and 2006 RX400h hybrid (Australia's first luxury hybrid SUV).
3.5L 2GR-FE V6 (RX350) and Atkinson-cycle hybrid (RX450h), Remote Touch controller.
Angular sharp styling, 2.0L Turbo (RX300), 3.5L V6, 3.5L Hybrid; available 7-seat RX L.
GA-K platform, RX350 (2.4L Turbo), RX350h, RX450h+ PHEV, and performance RX500h F Sport Performance (273kW).

nx.name: NX
nx.overview: Mid-size luxury crossover that quickly became Lexus's top-selling model line in Australia.

generations.summary: 2.0L Turbo 8AR-FTS (NX200t/NX300) and 2.5L Hybrid (NX300h); Luxury, F Sport, Sports Luxury.
GA-K platform, NX250, NX350 2.4L Turbo AWD, NX350h Hybrid, and NX450h+ Plug-in Hybrid (227kW).

lx.name: LX
lx.overview: Pinnacle luxury 4WD based on the Toyota LandCruiser, combining ultimate off-road durability with first-class opulence.

generations.summary: LandCruiser 80-based, 4.5L 1FZ-FE inline-6 petrol, leather and walnut trim.
LandCruiser 100-based, 4.7L 2UZ-FE V8, Adaptive Variable Suspension with Active Height Control.
5.7L 3UR-FE V8 (270kW/530Nm) and 2018 LX450d with 4.5L Twin-Turbo V8 diesel (200kW/650Nm).
TNGA-F platform, 3.3L Twin-Turbo V6 diesel (LX500d 227kW) and 3.5L Twin-Turbo V6 petrol (LX600 305kW); 4-seat Ultra Luxury VIP.
